data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Live Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Develop a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs for various metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Include a line chart for LLM cost over time.
Display stage completion rates using a bar chart.
Show success rate trends with an area chart.

features.title: Chart.js Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to visualize various data metrics within the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Include pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates using Chart.js.
Implement different chart types: line, bar, area, pie, and radar.
Charts should be interactive and visually appealing.

features.title: Feature Metrics Display
features.description: Showcase cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning metrics using charts.
acceptance_criteria: Display cost tracking metrics with appropriate charts.
Include sandboxing and learning metrics in the presentation.
Ensure metrics are accurate and up-to-date.

features.title: Pipeline Visualization
acceptance_criteria: Display an 8-stage pipeline using a suitable chart type.
Ensure each stage is clearly labeled and distinct.
Provide a visual representation that is easy to understand.

features.title: HTML Presentation Creation
features.description: Develop a standalone HTML presentation using existing demos as templates.
acceptance_criteria: Use templates from specified directory as a base.
Create a single HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript.
Ensure the file is standalone and does not require external resources.

features.title: Results Section
features.description: Showcase real metrics from recent runs in the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Include actual data from recent runs in the results section.
Ensure data is presented in a clear and concise manner.
Provide context for the metrics displayed.

features.title: HERO Section Development
features.description: Create a HERO section to introduce Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
acceptance_criteria: Clearly define what Artemis is in the HERO section.
Ensure the HERO section is visually engaging.
Include any necessary introductory information about Artemis.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Display code quality metrics using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Include TDD compliance and SOLID principles in the radar chart.
Ensure the radar chart is easy to interpret.
Provide accurate data for code quality metrics.

features.title: Professional Design
features.description: Enhance the presentation with a professional gradient background and smooth slide transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Apply a gradient background to the presentation.
Ensure transitions between slides are smooth and professional.
Maintain a consistent design theme throughout the presentation.

features.title: Integration Visualization
features.description: Illustrate supervisor integration across stages with a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Create a pie chart to represent supervisor integration.
Ensure the chart is clear and accurately represents data.
Provide context for the integration data shown.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality and navigation controls for the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Slides should auto-advance after a set duration.
Include navigation controls for manual slide navigation.
Ensure controls are intuitive and responsive.
